description:
As a ServiceNow AI & Automation Engineer at Honeywell Aerospace, you are responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining intelligent automation solutions and AI-enabled capabilities across the enterprise ServiceNow platform. This role focuses on leveraging ServiceNow’s native automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and integration capabilities to streamline business processes, improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the overall user and service experience. 

  

 You will report directly to our IT Manager and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on hybrid work schedule.

  

 The Engineer partners with the relevant platform and business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities, evaluate emerging technologies, and translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions. 

  

 This individual will play a key role in advancing the organization’s AI and automation strategy by leveraging ServiceNow capabilities, such as Now Assist, AI Agents, Flow Designer, integrationHub, Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, and other platform innovations.  

  

 The ideal candidate possesses strong ServiceNow development and engineering experience, practical knowledge of AI and automation technologies, integration expertise, and the ability to deliver enterprise-grade solutions aligned with platform governance, architecture, security, and development standards. 

  

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled solutions leveraging ServiceNow’s native AI capabilities and emerging platform technologies.  
 Evaluate and implement ServiceNow Now Assist capabilities, AI agents, generative AI, intelligent automation opportunities.  
 Partners with business and technical stakeholders to identify use cases where AI can improve productivity, decision-making, service delivery, and user experience. 
 Develop and configure AI-powered workflows, intelligent agents, and conversational experiences to automate routine activities and improve service outcomes.  
 Support the adoption and operationalization of AI capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, and other applicable ServiceNow products.  
 Establish appropriate AI governance, human oversight, security, and data quality practices to ensure responsible and effective AI implementation.  
 Monitor AI solution effectiveness, accuracy, adoption, and business value, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.  
 Ensure AI and automation solutions align with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements.  
 Partner with platform governance to establish standards for AI use cases, automation development, testing deployment, and on-going maintenance.  
 Ensure appropriate human-in-the-loop controls for AI-generated recommendations and automated decision-making.  
 Maintain appropriate technical documentation, testing evidence, and auditability for AI and automation solutions.  
 
 
 YOU MUST HAVE 
 Minimum 5 years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience  
 Minimum 3 years’ experience with workflow automation using flow designer, workflow studio, and workflow orchestration 
 Minimum 3 years’ experience with REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and enterprise system integrations  
 Certified ServiceNow (e.g., CSA, CAD, Integration related CIS)  
 Certified ITIL v4 
 Certified AI Professional, CTA, CSM, SAFe, Azure AI Engineer. 
 Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-enabled automation use-cases.  
 Proficiency in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes and Client Scripts 
 Commitment to delivering high-quality solutions that meet business requirements 
 Passion for optimizing, automating, and transforming processes and driving continuous improvement 
 Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple tasks simultaneously 
 Customer, end user, and stakeholder empathy 
 Servant mindset 
  
 WE VALUE 
 Bachelor’s degree in information technology or relevant area 
 Hands-on experience configuring and implementing Now Assist capabilities 
 Experience with ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, AI agents, and agent orchestration 
 Experience implementing LLM-based solutions, prompt engineering and AI-powered experiences.  
 Experience designing conversational experiences and intelligent self-service solutions 
 Familiarity with Python scripting and automation frameworks 
 Experience with robotic process automation (RPA), event-driven automation, and orchestration  
 Knowledge of responsible AI, data privacy, AI risk management, and human oversight  
  
  
 U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENTS 
 Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization. 
  
  
 BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE 
 Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes: 
 Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance 
 Short-term and long-term disability coverage 
 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts 
 Employee assistance program and educational assistance 
 Parental leave and 12 paid holidays 
 Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time 
 Explore your benefits:  https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ 
 

 ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE  
 Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.  
   
 Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 
   
 Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 
 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 
   
  
 ABOUT THE BUSINESS UNIT 
 CORPORATE 
 CONTROL SYSTEMS 
 ELECTRONIC SOLUTIONS 
 ENGINES & POWER SYSTEMS   
  
 Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:  
 Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft  
 Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying  
 Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board 
  
 With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses:  https://www.honeywellaerospace.com 
 

 
 The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date: 20-November-2026 .
